# CareerCraft AI

> AI job-search copilot for students and freshers. AI agents find real roles,
> tailor your resume to each job description, draft outreach, and prep you
> for interviews — you approve every action before anything is sent.

CareerCraft AI is bring-your-own-key: users supply their own API keys for
their chosen AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or a self-hosted
Ollama model). No agent applies to a job, sends an email, or submits a form
without the user's explicit approval first.
